reviewerNotes.developmentRuns: Before this recorded run, the reviewer ran two single sections of the same script against admin2 (logs kept only in scratch, not in the repository). SECTIONS=types (suffix mu4erz3c, record prefix 'DOC-029r2 admin-config' without 'walk') failed one step on a reviewer script error: the script turned off Show archived after Restore, but the switch is not shown when no archived Field is left. The app had archived and restored the Field (audit field.archived and field.restored). SECTIONS=forms (suffix mu4ev57k) passed every step and removed its deflection links and turned off Portal-listed on its Entity. Both runs left fictional types, Fields, Statuses, an Officer role, Entities, Matters and Requests with those suffixes. The record prefix then changed to 'DOC-029r2 admin-config walk' so the link cleanup cannot match records from another agent.
reviewerNotes.sharedLab: The admin2 lab was shared. Records named 'DOC-029r2 admin-config compat ... mu4eht6p' came from another agent and were not changed by this walkthrough. The Audit log counts (46 org_settings.updated rows) include lead time changes by other runs on this lab.
observations: Add rows for types, request types, Contract and Matter Statuses, Officer roles and reminder lead times now show Save (Save status for Statuses) and Cancel. Save is disabled while the name box is blank. Cancel discards the draft.
A refused lead time (duplicate, 731, 21st entry) keeps the draft open with the message beside Save and Cancel.
The step 3-5 lead time result text still says 'open add row after Enter'. That is stale wording copied from walkthrough-r1.mjs; the script selected Save.
The Reminder lead times page note still reads 'One list covers every tracked date'. The article's per-Key-date lead times match the observed behaviour (the Key date's own 12-day lead time fired).
Archive type with 'No reassignment' on an in-use Matter type still leaves the dialog open with no message, and nothing changes.
The Field archive dialog counted a Field attached to one Matter type (after Detach from the Contract type) as 'attached to 2 types'.
Entities > Fields shows one Fields card with Add field and no Default fields card, which matches the article's 'Matter and Contract Fields settings'.
limitations: Independent agent walkthrough, not a human user study.
The bell contents were read from GET /api/v1/notifications as the colleague; the browser checked only the header bell count.
The morning round was queued in the lab worker through pg-boss on the real clock; no clock change.

Not checked in the browser: requiredness at type change; every Stage or Category keeping a live Status; failed multi-part Field saves; the AI prompt; renaming and reordering request types; Department carry-through; a turnaround of 0 meaning the submission date; expiry, notice deadline and Entity Obligation reminders; email preference switches; Search not covering record content.
The archived-target check set a request type Target through PATCH /api/v1/request-types/<id>, because the editor has no Target control.
Screenshots from this run went to a scratch directory and were not kept.
